notes.title: Ukrainian is coming to Outbound!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44876996/e61bf5c55af3d734d684d930f4f1bb13ad118f62.png[/img]

Hey, travellers!

Some of you might have already spotted the news on Twitter, but it’s worth saying loud and clear: Outbound will include Ukrainian language support when it launches! 💛💙

You asked, we listened - and it’s about time. Thank you to everyone who shared their feedback and kept the requests coming. We can’t wait to hit the road together 🥰 [b]Are there more languages that we need to add to the game? Please let us know![/b]

And just so you don’t miss a thing: we’ll now be posting monthly updates here on Steam to keep you in the loop as we roll toward launch. 🚐

Want to hang out with us? Come join our Discord server!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44876996/47fcb25d841473ddf25b29bae20262335f97a86c.png"][/img]

Want quick updates, behind-the-scenes looks, and sneak previews?
[url="https://x.com/OutboundTheGame"]👉 Follow us on Twitter/X[/url]

Thanks for being part of the ride! 
- The Outbound Team 🚐💨

tags.feature: Outbound will include Ukrainian language support when it launches!

notes.title: Outbound x Star Birds Collab!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44876996/fd47a3c1c6442645a5151d117b3d36b78ee2585d.png[/img]

At Gamescom we met our new friends from [b]Toukana Interactive[/b] and [b]kurzgesagt - in a nutshell[/b], the teams behind the recently released [b]cozy asteroid resource manager Star Birds[/b]! We've teamed up with them to bring something really cool to you!

Freshly flown in for the Star Birds release, there’s now a special item for all indie lovers - drum roll, please! 🥁 - you can now unlock [b]a minifigure of the iconic campervan from Outbound for the main menu in Star Birds[/b].

To get it, simply click on the button with the gift icon 🎁 in the top right corner of the Star Birds main menu, then enter the code "outbound" in and hit the checkmark button.

Do you want us to add a free Star Birds cosmetic item in Outbound, too? Let us know in the comments what we should add as a thank you!

[h2]Get Star Birds on Steam[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2719750/Star_Birds/?utm_source=outbound&utm_campaign=crossnews

notes.title: Closed Alpha Start!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44876996/d96e71bd2dd8171d7cb46699d72c57454edd44f3.png[/img]

Outbound was part of today's [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rnNhA7vLgZ0]Triple-I showcase[/url] and we announced the start of the [b]Closed Alpha on April 14th[/b]!

The Closed Alpha is an early build of the game and we want to test mechanics and overall stability with a limited number of players. With a little bit of luck, you can also join! We start to regularly invite randomly selected newsletter subscribers to join the Alpha starting on April 14th!

[b][url=https://www.squareglade.games]Join the Alpha here[/url][/b]

The Alpha contains the first playable biome and most of the features. We will use the Alpha to iron out bugs and to overall shape and polish the game based on player feedback.

If you are a Content Creator, you can apply for a key here if you meet the requirements.
[url=https://forms.gle/AzJYkthdQzk73iuJA][b]Apply as Content Creator[/b][/url]

[h1]Alpha Trailer![/h1]
[previewyoutube=s9B9xl_cPA8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]What is part of the Alpha?[/h1]
We are happy to give you an overview of the current state of the game as well as features that are planned for the future!

[h2]The First Biome[/h2]
The Alpha offers the first biome for players to explore. The first biomes consists of lush forests, open plains, wide wheat fields, mountains, and more!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44876996/8a5962ed12405c6b46d4b8d97fd51c0e813d163b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44876996/257e790b04a3e2406111d1327f68fe2ffe76bea7.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44876996/02ef0fb66cda20cf525cd9fd1da49d6f390d57e6.jpg[/img]

[h2]Playing together[/h2]
You can already play Outbound together with up to 4 players. You are sharing one vehicle and go together on a roadtrip! In contrast to singleplayer, multiplayer is in an experimental state since we are still encountering stability issues.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44876996/35809cd102708f3bc566121e45906d504275d148.jpg[/img]

[h2]Building[/h2]
You can build workstations, furniture, and decorations inside your vehicle. With a certain vehicle upgrade, you can also build foundations and walls on top of it with our modular building system! You also have the option to set camp and build certain items next to the vehicle.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44876996/6a5fbab6e80a3ee9cc7df88b9f4ab53b14c8880b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44876996/856799366a22a516522f27137f005c42eeb0ed82.jpg[/img]

[h2]Scavenging and Crafting[/h2]
Outbound already offers a wide variety of materials that can be found and put into your vehicle. The vehicle functions as a handy shared inventory that all players can access (no need to build chests!). You can also transfer materials directly from the vehicle to any workstation to process them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44876996/4dcda3944838151908c4358e5c92bfe4a017bfc5.jpg[/img]

[h2]Finding new Blueprints[/h2]
While exploring the world of Outbound, you will come across various points of interest and signal towers. From these you are able to download blueprints to add to your workbench or build menu. Most of the signal towers will provide multiple options to choose from. The offered options can vary from player to player, so each playthrough should feel fresh and different. From time to time, old signal towers will provide a new signal, so you can go back and complete your blueprint collection.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44876996/5f6971ad43afa05bce310770138734988e519c0b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44876996/f960b07151dcd4ff06f158a8cc71c9d4ab78bb2e.png[/img]

[h2]Source Energy[/h2]
In the beginning, the vehicle uses a bio burner that can burn biodegradable resources to fuel the electric motor. When progressing the game you will be able to expand and ultimately replace the bio burner with solar and wind energy, building a fully sustainable energy solution for your vehicle.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44876996/66ee6f1d4e34d6c6f6765c979002abf75cfbba7a.png[/img]

[h2]Dynamic Environments[/h2]
Next to a dynamic day-night-cycle, Outbound also offers a dynamic weather system. Depending on the current conditions, the same location can feel very different and will be inhabited by different wildlife.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44876996/90a473cfbbac6d67d19d0e564e8c3b917d6da4ef.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44876996/4db364bb912d7f0a3933b9c758efaab8a21980c1.jpg[/img]

[h2]More Features![/h2]
These are also part of the alpha!
[list]
[*] Player needs
[*] Various craftable tools
[*] Map and compass
[*] Collectibles to find
[*] Farming / cultivation
[*] Cooking
[*] Material processing
[*] Vehicle and player upgrades
[*] Some environmental puzzles and interactions
[/list]

[h1]What is still in development[/h1]
Outbound is still in development, therefore a couple of features are still missing, but are planned for the rest of the development time:
[list]
[*] The dog companion
[*] Character customization
[*] Fishing
[*] Bee keeping
[*] More vehicle options to choose from
[*] Vehicle needs
[*] More biomes
[*] The journal
[*] Controller support
[*] Language support
[*] Accessibility options (and some other settings)
[*] More materials, building pieces, workstations, etc.
[*] and more!
[/list]

notes.title: 🐶 Companion unlocked!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44876996/dcd7e4d458adcb3f887fd960547085c246fb367b.png[/img]

Thanks to the successful Kickstarter, we've reached another stretch goal and will add a Dog Companion to Outbound! 🐶✨

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/squareglade/outbound][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44876996/04281b8d51ac351711c5e44742c0cfd30a1b7bc0.png[/img][/url]

Originally, we didn't plan on adding a companion to Outbound, but we are very thankful that you care so much about the game that you brought this incredible idea up! This is a huge milestone for us, and we couldn't have done it without each and every one of you.

Our artists worked really hard on creating a cute and fitting companion for Outbound and we are happy to share the design today! Everybody is different, and therefore we want to offer multiple in-game skins for the companion. You can customize your companion to your liking! 😊

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44876996/e1f09de3a853b506e9ae458aee019e75b8a19bd9.gif[/img]

[h2]Companion Gameplay[/h2]
We have also been very hard at work programming a prototype for the companion!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44876996/1d755d4a8025f678bfdcfdf3f77465af07dd6b81.png[/img]

You will be able to give commands such as picking up an item or directing your companion to a certain position.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44876996/10ecbeaa5fe43e3475f0d0c6b48f0eb35b7ca050.gif[/img]

You will also be able to put things from your backpack into your companion's pouch! Your companion can even store its items into your vehicle for you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44876996/7d55c47b3bdcfc41bba123038e07a5a0a2f63d15.gif[/img]

[h2]Cotton Candy & Marshmallow Skins![/h2]
We created two special skins: [b]Cotton Candy & Marshmallow[/b]! These can be acquired as a Kickstarter add-on! You can add them to your pledge when backing the project on Kickstarter to give your companion a unique and very cute look! :)

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/squareglade/outbound][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44876996/9c9eb0783f510805e2014b4b4a0817218bc83987.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Thank You! ❤️[/h2]
We are beyond grateful for your incredible support. Reaching this goal is not just a testament to the game we’re building, but also to the amazing group of people who believe in it. You’re helping us create something truly special, and we can’t wait to see where this journey takes us all! 🤩

Thank you from the bottom of our hearts for being part of Outbound. Stay cozy, keep dreaming, and let’s continue making Outbound the best it can be together!

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/squareglade/outbound][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44876996/434e2207ebee810f5bdf01cde81452d5d716c3f4.png[/img][/url]

[url=https://discord.com/invite/HwBgTMr4WU][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44876996/442092fccb8e014fc06dd48ef3fad5e74a1ea8d1.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Get Alpha Access NOW!
notes.content:
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/266687617/outbound][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44876996/92417f50272d3e23a909e6786491130b461c5988.png[/img][/url]

Finally! We are excited to announce that our highly anticipated cozy camper-exploration game Outbound is now live on Kickstarter! Back now to receive exclusive cosmetics, Alpha access, and more!

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/squareglade/outbound][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44876996/434e2207ebee810f5bdf01cde81452d5d716c3f4.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Watch the official Kickstarter Trailer![/h2]
[previewyoutube=QB8nHW6oflI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Get Alpha Access![/h2]
There will be a closed Alpha for Outbound and Kickstarter backers will be able to participate. Be the first to play and help us shape the game with your feedback!

[h2]Roadmap[/h2]
We are also excited to reveal our roadmap! Backers that get Alpha access will be able to play first in our closed Alpha. Later in the year Beta backers will get a chance to play, and finally we will launch the game with a 1.0 version on Steam and other platforms.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44876996/8ab90d6d6d8f90f1b1c8dc154cff37af429a3232.png[/img]

[h2]Kickstarter-exclusive cosmetics![/h2]
We want to give backers who support us on Kickstarter something special. You can be among the few to receive limited edition, Kickstarter-only cosmetics to decorate your home on wheels! Among the rewards there are for example an avocado-themed rear view mirror charm, as well as an avocado-themed furniture set!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44876996/f0597ec4969757e47047657050ff993488c93d33.png[/img]

And there are many more amazing rewards... Make sure to head over to Kickstarter and [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/266687617/outbound]Check out the Campaign[/url]!

Cheers,
Tobi & Marc

[url=https://discord.com/invite/HwBgTMr4WU][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44876996/442092fccb8e014fc06dd48ef3fad5e74a1ea8d1.png[/img][/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2681030/Outbound/

notes.title: 🎉 Outbound Kickstarter Launch Date Reveal!
notes.content:
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/266687617/outbound][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44876996/9b19259a6c3a1b957b1571cb2248c6e37e3d3b79.png[/img][/url]

Finally! We are excited to announce that our highly anticipated cozy camper-exploration game Outbound will launch on Kickstarter on:

[h2]🎉 August 13th 🎉[/h2]

Make sure to mark the date in your calendars!
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/266687617/outbound][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44876996/f6ab66aa417a01505dd7be5ce3f3ea71cffdd75d.png[/img][/url]

Watch the official Kickstarter teaser below!
[previewyoutube=oDvVeZliSag;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2681030/Outbound/

[h2]We will reveal more Content![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44876996/2b0334f8d1647207684747718f11710fdeeffbaa.png[/img]
Together with the Kickstarter campaign we will also reveal more content, such as new biomes, new vehicles, and features! You will also get in-depth information on the game loop and our roadmap!

[h2]Get Alpha Access![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44876996/c281f1ec026744535971299a61faf9b208882a28.png[/img]
There will be a closed Alpha for Outbound and Kickstarter backers will be able to participate. Be the first to play and help us shape the game with your feedback! The exact time frame of the Alpha will be revealed together with the Kickstarter campaign.

[h2]Kickstarter-exclusive cosmetics![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44876996/59323bffd876219cd9f0f36be2eaf29a29057534.png[/img]
We want to give backers who support us on Kickstarter something special. You can be among the few to receive limited edition, Kickstarter-only cosmetics to decorate your home on wheels!

[h2]Early Bird discounts![/h2]
Make sure to get notified when the campaign launches with the calendar file attached and save big on Early Bird discounts! You can also get notified for the Kickstarter launch via Kickstarter or Discord!

[h2]Official Soundtrack[/h2]
We are thrilled to announce that the incredible [url=https://tylerzanemusic.com]Tyler Zane[/url] is the official composer for Outbound! He is crafting a beautiful soundtrack to enhance the game's atmosphere - as he already did with our previous game Above Snakes. You can already listen to a sneak peek of his work:
[previewyoutube=HQAtYgXjTAc;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Pre-launch Giveaways![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44876996/8cd5e6da94fadad879cdff96da6528ac6ac07da9.png[/img]
Hope you are as excited for the Kickstarter as we are! Make sure to join our Discord to enter our pre-Kickstarter giveaways that we will run within the next couple of weeks until launch! You will be able to win Celestial Tickets to double your rewards when backing the campaign!

Cheers,
Tobi & Marc

[url=https://discord.com/invite/HwBgTMr4WU][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44876996/8d03600f6a12b1334946593b28abb12f6b077256.gif[/img][/url]
